newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas Advertising sees healthy profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Havas Advertising sees healthy profit rise.

text.p: France's Havas Advertising believes its profits could double within three years, chairman Alain de Pouzilhac said in an newspaper interview to be published on Saturday.

"Three years from now Havas advertising should see its gross operating income exceed five billion (francs) and its profits double," he was quoted as saying in the interview in the Journal de Finances, a copy of which was supplied to Reuters.

He said 1996 should be the best year since its creation in 1991 by the merger of Eurocom and RSCG. Gross operating income in the first half progressed by 6.4 percent on a like-for-like basis and the trend in the second half was even better, he said.
"For the year as a whole, it should rise between seven and eight percent and in this light we should be able to announce a healthy advance in profits in 1996," he was quoted as saying.
